correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact map T=u+alpha^(-1)(P-I)phi(u), the weighted invariant stationary measure and nonreversible Dirichlet-form energy identity. Taylor with 0<=phi'<=A proves sufficiency of alpha>=A/2, while linear flux plus a mean-zero field gives necessary failure below. For f=e_i/pi_i-1 and g=P_tf, the exact positive quadratic identity P_ii/pi_i-1=||g||_pi^2-t<Qg,g>_pi>=0 proves the nonreversible stationary return lower bound; ergodicity proves its sharp limit. Jacobian entry signs yield sufficiency of alpha>=A(1-pi_min), and the linear flux with input e_i yields actual negative output for a finite large step below it. The proof covers all n>=2 and all specified quantifiers. A standalone package checker passed 976 exact/numerical assertions but is supplemental only.

value.rationale: Nonlinear EIN diffusion requires both energy dissipation and pointwise physical admissibility. The known half-derivative energy stabilization does not prevent negative concentrations even on a directed three-cycle. The exact threshold A(1-pi_min) is a natural, graph-intrinsic, time-step- and jump-rate-independent selection rule, with an all-generator proof and matching failure witness. It supplies an actionable boundary between two meaningful numerical properties without claiming an implementation-sized solver advance.
